name: ListRuns

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the workspace where the experiment resides. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.

If you do not specify a workspace ID, the system returns the list of runs in the default workspace
parameters.help_zh:
实验所在工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。
不填写工作空间ID，系统将返回默认工作空间的运行列表
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment to which the run belongs
parameters.name: experiment_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the PAI workload associated with the run
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PAI workload associated with the run
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en:
The labels of the run for an exact match. The following formats are supported:

Single-label query: "is_evaluation:true"

Multi-label query: "is_evaluation:true,LLM_evaluation:true". This method is not recommended for common scenarios because it may degrade performance. Use commas (,) to separate multiple labels. The system matches all specified key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh:
任务的标签，精确匹配。支持：
单标签查询："is_evaluation:true"
多标签场景（非特殊场景不推荐，可能存在性能问题）："is_evaluation:true,LLM_evaluation:true" 使用半角逗号（,）分隔，表示多个标签key-value需要同时匹配
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display details, including Metrics, Params, and Labels. Valid values:

true: displays details.

false (default): does not display details
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示详细信息，包括：Metrics、Params和Labels。取值如下：
true：表示展示详细信息。
false（默认值）：表示不展示详细信息

parameters.help_en: The time when the instance was created
parameters.name: gmt_create_time

parameters.help_zh: 排序方式的字符串列表，支持排序的字段包括：GmtCreateTime、Name。排序方式包括DESC和ASC，默认为ASC。支持多个字段，用半角逗号","分隔
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The paging token. The value starts from 0. The default value is 0
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.help_zh: 请求的最大结果数，默认为10

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数。 取值范围：大于0。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field to use for sorting. Valid values:

Name: the name of the run.

GmtCreateTime (default): the time when the run was created
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序的字段名，取值如下：
Name：Run名称。
GmtCreateTime（默认值）：Run创建时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order for the paged query. Use this parameter with SortBy.

ASC: ascending order.

DESC (default): descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序，与SortBy结合使用。
ASC：升序。
DESC（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: order

NextPageToken.description_en: The paging token. For the first query, leave this parameter empty. The token for the next page is returned in the response. If the returned token is 0, all results have been returned. You can obtain the token for the next page from the NextPageToken field in the response
NextPageToken.description_zh: 分页token，首页查询时传空，查询结果中返回下一页token地址。当结果token为0时表示全部查完。可通过查询结果中的NextPageToken字段获取下一页token
